paragraphs.text: Wylie Duke is a legendary Atiin ranger from an unknown plane.

Wylie is a character that introduced in Outlaws of Thunder Junction . He is from an unknown plane who arrived on Thunder Junction after the opening of the Omenpaths . He is a member of the Atiin and is considered a hero among his people. He visited a few planes between 4562 AR and c. 4563 AR . After arriving on Thunder Junction, he joined the Freestriders . He rides upon a white horse and wields a type of mana gun.
